scope: Existing v6 entity semantics and high-risk matching rules. No QR index changes.

records.finding: Kenyan 'Factory' is a recognized smallholder coffee processing/collection unit within the cooperative system. It must not be normalized to estate/farm merely because retail labels use the word factory loosely.
Retain as a factory-type origin entity. Do not merge automatically with similarly spelled entities without cooperative/county evidence.
Retain factory terminology in English and use Chinese '处理厂/咖啡厂' only as display translation; entity role remains factory.

Do not equate Kieni with similarly named Kie/Kiini/Kianjogu-like factory names from registry or yearbook text without exact location/cooperative evidence. Similar spelling is not sufficient for merge.
Rwanda CWS status is operational-year dependent. A station observed active in 2024 should be recorded with temporal evidence rather than a permanent 'active forever' attribute.

matchingGuardrails: Never merge entities by normalized name alone.
Require country plus at least one of region/county/district/cooperative/operator or authoritative exact identity.
Preserve original-language/official English names alongside Chinese display translations.
AI may propose matches but cannot promote a fuzzy entity match to canonical without rule/source confirmation.
Ownership, cooperative membership and operator relations must support validFrom/validTo or observedAt when derived from annual sources.
